response.overview: When Kyaw Moe Naing, a wealthy Myanmar banker in his forties living in Switzerland, meets twenty-year-old Hnin Phyu one day, everything in his life changes. Not only does Hnin Phyu look exactly like his fiancée who died in an avalanche in the Swiss Alps twenty years before, but she also shares some memories with the dead girl. Trying to resolve the mystery, Kyaw Moe Naing comes to the conclusion that Hnin Phyu must be the reincarnation of his dead fiancée. But when he discovers the truth, everything he believes in breaks down and his life is in sudden danger.
response.title: Shadows of the Past
